swizzle_blockscale_scale: swizzle the FP4 block-scales tensor to match the CUTLASS kernel data layout by padding and block-interleaving
cutlass_fp4_supported_check: check whether the current CUDA device supports CUTLASS FP4 scaled matrix multiplication
pad_nvfp4_weight_for_cutlass_weight: pad packed NVFP4 weights so both row and column dimensions satisfy CUTLASS alignment constraints
pad_nvfp4_activation_for_cutlass_x_fp4: pad packed FP4 activations to match the K-dimension padding applied to weights
slice_nvfp4_output_out: slice the output tensor to remove N-dimension padding after a padded CUTLASS FP4 matmul
